items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: Did you crack up with the video of that song with Chevy Chase?

ctx.x: Yeah. Right. One [scats]. Yes it’s rests on the downbeats of both bars. Yeah. But it’s just what the rhythm guitarist played. Like give it to three trumpets and three trombones and a bass saxophone and make the registers work nice. I think actually toward the end somewhere it jumps up one inversion.
Yes, I believe it does. Did you crack up with the video of that song with Chevy Chase?
No. Not really. It was okay.
